evidence_cannot_become_instruction.mechanism: untrusted source kinds seal into the EVIDENCE_DATA or MODEL_OUTPUT plane with a frozen disposition where instructionEligible and authorityEligible are false; the data-only allowlist contains transforms only, so requesting an instruction use fails closed with UNTRUSTED_USE_DENIED, and assembleDataOnlyContext exposes neither an instruction nor a messages field. A clean prompt-injection scan and a trusted extraction label never upgrade the plane

model_output_cannot_self_authorize.mechanism: denyUntrustedAuthorityRequest returns a frozen DENY / UNTRUSTED_ORIGIN decision with empty capabilityGrantIds, approvalRecordIds, policyDecisionIds, phaseTransitionIds, and instructionIds for every request type including unknown future actions, and never inspects the persuasive content; sidecar role, approval, capability, policy, or phase fields are rejected with UNEXPECTED_FIELD rather than interpreted
